verdict.rationale: Independent reviews (Tom's Hardware, HN threads citing power draw) note the 285K is faster and more power-efficient than its 14900K predecessor, and comm-3 lists 'power consumption and efficiency' as a pro, but the same sources say AMD's 9950X beats it in perf-per-watt and one HN comment flags 'possibly much higher power consumption.' No first-party documented power envelope/TDP-vs-sustained-render data is present in the pack. missing for 10: official sustained power/TDP specs for 285K, dedicated long-render throttling benchmarks, and independent corroboration that it beats competitors on perf/watt rather than just its own predecessor.
